files.purpose: Plant and DC capacities, fixed costs, handling costs, geographical coordinates
Multi-echelon transportation corridors, freight rates, transit times, capacities
24-month historical demand curve with North India trend and regime shift at month 20
Raw customer orders with valid dispatches and 4 deliberate validation test cases

intentional_edge_cases.A_normal_valid_data: Standard multi-echelon network flows across North, West, South, East, and Northeast corridors.
intentional_edge_cases.B_meaningful_demand_trend: North India demand growing steadily from 7,100 u/d to 10,800 u/d over 24 periods.
intentional_edge_cases.C_structural_change_regime_shift: North India demand accelerating steeply from period 20 onward (9,200 -> 10,800).
intentional_edge_cases.D_forecast_history_depth: 24 full monthly historical observations allowing QuantileRegression_HiGHS with 6-month horizon.
intentional_edge_cases.E_network_redundancy_disruption: Kolkata DC (53% util) and Mumbai DC (75% util) have spare capacity to absorb Delhi NCR DC (94% util) overflow.
intentional_edge_cases.F_controlled_infeasible_scenario: Capacity reduction of Delhi NCR DC by >8,000 units with locked corridors causing unserved demand penalty.
